svg.aria-label: OpenShell on Kubernetes lab architecture: a single Brev VM running k3s with Envoy Gateway, the OpenShell gateway and console, one namespace per workspace (openshell-lab-default with agent-0 and agent-1, openshell-lab-team-a with lab-a), each sandbox a workload pod and a supervisor pod, Keycloak, LiteLLM, cert-manager, Kyverno, agent-sandbox controller and a monitoring stack.
